I/O API for bstream reads, appends, commit, recovery, and block-device or memory-backed storage.

# Purpose
This header defines the `fd_vinyl_io` interface for reading and writing a bstream on a physical storage layer. It declares an abstract I/O handle, an implementation table of function pointers, and inline wrappers for operations such as `read_imm`, `read`, `poll`, `append`, `commit`, `hint`, `alloc`, `copy`, `forget`, `rewind`, `sync`, and `fini`. The file also defines helper functions and append helpers for vinyl records, plus two concrete back ends: `fd_vinyl_io_bd` for a block device or file and `fd_vinyl_io_mm` for a memory-backed store. It also exposes accessors for the raw mapped storage with [`fd_vinyl_mmio`](<#fd_vinyl_mmio>) and [`fd_vinyl_mmio_sz`](<#fd_vinyl_mmio_sz>) to support recovery and parallel access.
